item_short_desc: Keep your shirt neatly tucked in for a clean and professional appearance with Rothco’s Y-Style Shirt Stays. These stays feature Y-style double shirt clips, ensuring that your uniform shirt remains tucked even if 1 clip comes loose. They fasten to the top of your socks, preventing both your shirt from becoming untucked and your socks from rolling down. Designed with lightweight and discreet materials, these shirt stays are perfect for various settings, including workplaces, field work, weddings, and casual wear.
